pain_points.statement: Invoicing data discrepancies between Salesforce and the dispatch system leave finance three weeks behind on billing, trapping cash flow.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

pain_points.statement: Leadership is divided on the Phase 1 budget limit.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Rita, the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap. / Rita, that's not what we discussed. We discussed a six-month Phase 1 in the $250 to $400 range...
pain_points.contradiction_note: CFO Rita enforces a strict $300,000 budget cap, whereas VP of Operations Sarah understood Phase 1 to be budgeted between $250,000 and $400,000.

desired_state.statement: Secure a fixed-fee agreement with clear milestone payments tied to concrete business outcomes rather than time-and-materials.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'll give you a fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes... I want a number in the proposal. Not a range. A number.

success_criteria.statement: Return invoicing DSO to the 5-day industry standard, unlocking $1.4M in trapped working capital.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a return to five-day DSO from where we are now frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

success_criteria.statement: Avoid $320k in annual dispatcher headcount costs by increasing operational efficiency.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time means we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k in fully-loaded comp.

risks_unknowns.statement: The CFO is skeptical of consulting engagements after a negative experience with a previous vendor in 2023.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.

pain_points.statement: The legacy custom Rails dispatch app accumulates severe technical debt, making feature additions slow and fragile.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile. Every change takes three times as long as it should.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must execute manual double-entry between the custom Rails dispatch tool and Salesforce.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: Build workflow logic as an abstraction layer over Routemaster with clean APIs to Salesforce and mobile clients.
desired_state.source_excerpt: workflow logic in a layer on top of Routemaster, talking to Salesforce and the driver app through clean integration points

desired_state.statement: Stakeholders disagree on whether to fix existing platform workflows or replace Routemaster entirely.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus advocates replacing Routemaster with a $600k/yr SaaS platform, whereas VP Ops Sarah wants to resolve workflow pain points on the current platform.

success_criteria.statement: Ensure 60% to 70% of the Phase 1 technical development remains reusable if Routemaster is replaced in the future.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Full technical viability and architecture reuse depend on reviewing Routemaster's schema and access patterns.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Read access to Routemaster — at least the schema and a representative slice of the data.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend excessive time on manual tasks across disconnected software tools.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Our dispatcher workflow is killing us. Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: Contracted drivers express strong dissatisfaction with the legacy mobile application.

desired_state.statement: Streamline dispatcher workflows to eliminate double-entry and operational bottlenecks.
desired_state.source_excerpt: the workflow fixes are needed regardless because the dispatchers can't keep working this way.

success_criteria.statement: Achieve a 30% reduction in dispatch handling time per load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Sarah and I talked about a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: Two previous internal projects attempting to solve dispatcher workflow issues failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

risks_unknowns.statement: Deferring mobile driver app updates may cause operational friction with required ELD work streams.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD work is in the driver app, which Alex just said he's deferring.

pain_points.statement: Recent acquisition growth has left systems and operational processes incompletely integrated.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Replicate operational success and modernization standards achieved by peer brokerages like Cascade Freight.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah has asked us specifically because we did similar work for a peer brokerage (Cascade Freight) in 2024.

success_criteria.statement: Stakeholders disagree on the required target release deadline for the production pilot.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3. I think Q4 is more realistic if we're doing it right.
success_criteria.contradiction_note: CFO Rita and VP Ops Sarah require a production pilot by end of Q3 to retain project funding, whereas CTO Marcus asserts Q4 is the only realistic timeline.

risks_unknowns.statement: Upcoming November 15 federal ELD compliance mandates pose legal risks to operating authority if uncoordinated.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real... Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.
